title: sohmaea gracillima
intro: Sohmaea gracillima, commonly known as the African bloodwood or the African stinkwood, is a tree species native to tropical Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic activities, which can aid in wound healing and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Sohmaea gracillima include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and treat respiratory problems due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
